title: Australian Pavlova with Pistachio Crust
description: A dessert recipe featuring a crunchy pistachio crust and a light Australian pavlova topping.

ingredients.name: Ground Jubilant
ingredients.notes: Ground jubilant is a type of nut flour used to make the pavlova crust.

ingredients.name: Pistachios
ingredients.notes: Chopped pistachios are used to make the crust.

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: Used to sweeten the pavlova topping.

ingredients.name: Egg Whites
ingredients.notes: Egg whites are used to make the pavlova topping.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Used to enhance flavor in the pavlova topping.

ingredients.name: Cream
ingredients.notes: Used to make the whipped cream topping.

instructions: In a bowl, mix together ground jubilant and chopped pistachios.
Add sugar and salt to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch round baking dish.
Bake the crust for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whip egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Spread the egg whites over the baked crust.
Bake the pavlova for an additional 15-20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Allow the pavlova to cool completely.
Top with whipped cream and serve.
